# Commerce Layer

> Commerce Layer is an API-first, headless commerce platform that provides
> the infrastructure for globally distributed, multi-market ecommerce. It
> enables AI agents, developers, and brands to sell everywhere — online,
> in-store, via mobile apps, shoppable links, IoT devices, and autonomous
> AI agent commerce.

## Product

- [Universal Checkout](https://commercelayer.io/universal-checkout): API-first, stateless
  checkout to sell on any channel. Supports multiple markets and currencies,
  any payment gateway or tax calculator.
- [Distributed OMS](https://commercelayer.io/distributed-oms): Manage
  inventory across multiple stock locations with real-time unified visibility,
  automatic reservation, and intelligent order splitting.
- [Promotion Engine](https://commercelayer.io/promotion-engine): Market-specific promotion
  rules via a visual editor or JSON-based Rules Engine DSL. Supports tiered
  discounts, bundle promotions, employee pricing, and custom conditions on
  any order attribute.
- [POS System](https://commercelayer.io/pos-system): In-store commerce engine integrated
  with online channels, sharing customer profiles across touchpoints.

## Platform Capabilities

- 400+ API endpoints across the Core API
- Average API response time: <90ms
- 100+ real-time webhook trigger events
- 99.99% uptime SLA
- 60+ global CDN edge nodes
- Multi-market configuration out of the box
- SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS certified

## Developer Documentation

- [Core API — Getting Started](https://docs.commercelayer.io/core): REST API
  fundamentals, authentication, CRUD operations, filtering, webhooks, pagination.
- [API Reference](https://docs.commercelayer.io/core-api-reference): Complete
  list of all 400+ Commerce Layer resources, object structures, and operations.
- [API Specification](https://docs.commercelayer.io/core/api-specification):
  OpenAPI-compliant spec for code generation, mock servers, contract testing.
- [Metrics API](https://docs.commercelayer.io/metrics): Extract analytics from
  commerce data — conversion rates, customer behavior, custom reports.
- [Provisioning API](https://docs.commercelayer.io/provisioning): Automate
  account management, API credentials, and team onboarding programmatically.
- [AI & Agentic Commerce](https://docs.commercelayer.io/ai): How AI agents
  interact with Commerce Layer — MCP servers for schema-aware API access,
  MCP Inspector for debugging, and security controls for token scoping and
  approval workflows.
- [Rules Engine](https://docs.commercelayer.io/rules-engine): DSL for defining
  conditions and actions evaluated against order and price payloads. Covers
  order promotion rules, price list rules, dot-notation condition syntax, and
  Core API integration.

## Pre-Built Applications (Open Source)

- [Cart](https://github.com/commercelayer/mfe-cart): React-based
  shopping cart.
- [Checkout](https://github.com/commercelayer/mfe-checkout):
  React-based hosted checkout.
- [My Account](https://github.com/commercelayer/mfe-my-account):
  Customer portal — addresses, payment sources, order history.
- [Identity](https://github.com/commercelayer/mfe-identity):
  Customer login and sign-up flows.
- [Microstore](https://github.com/commercelayer/mfe-microstore):
  Self-contained store via URL with query string configuration.
- [Demo Store](https://github.com/commercelayer/commercelayer-demo-store):
  Fully static ecommerce template powered by Commerce Layer.

## Developer Tools & SDKs

- [Core MCP Server](https://commercelayer.io/blog/core-mcp-server):
  Model Context Protocol server giving AI agents schema-aware, permission-safe
  access to the full Core API — resource discovery, query validation, and
  documentation retrieval in a single interface.
- [JS Auth](https://github.com/commercelayer/commercelayer-js-auth):
  Lightweight authentication library with token caching.
- [JS SDK](https://github.com/commercelayer/commercelayer-sdk): JavaScript
  wrapper for Commerce Layer API, browser and Node.js.
- [Drop-in Library](https://github.com/commercelayer/drop-in.js): Turns any
  HTML page into a shoppable experience.
- [CLI](https://github.com/commercelayer/commercelayer-cli): Command Line
  Interface for managing Commerce Layer data from the terminal.
- [React Components](https://github.com/commercelayer/commercelayer-react-components):
  Component library for building custom UIs with React.
- [Dashboard Apps](https://github.com/commercelayer/dashboard-apps):
  Open-source, customizable admin dashboard applications (orders, inventory,
  promotions, etc.) built as a monorepo. Clone, extend, and self-host on
  Netlify or Vercel.
- [App Elements](https://github.com/commercelayer/app-elements):
  React UI component library used by Dashboard Apps. Provides reusable
  components, hooks, and helpers for building Commerce Layer admin interfaces.
- [Examples](https://github.com/commercelayer/examples):
  Reference implementations across authentication (MFA, SSO), CMS integrations,
  serverless functions, search, webhooks, and general API use cases — each
  paired with a tutorial.
  
## Pricing

- [Pricing Page](https://commercelayer.io/pricing): Full plan details.
- Developer Plan: Free forever. 1 organization, 2 users, 2 markets, 1,000 SKUs,
  10 links, 100 free live orders/month. Unlimited test orders.
- Enterprise Plan: Custom pricing. Unlimited organizations, users, markets,
  SKUs, and links. Includes Metrics API, Provisioning API, dedicated support,
  custom user roles, custom identity provider, and enterprise SLAs.

## Blog & Resources

- [Blog](https://commercelayer.io/blog): Headless commerce, API-first
  architecture, and platform news.
- [Commerce Layer Core MCP](https://commercelayer.io/blog/core-mcp-server):
  How the Core MCP server gives AI agents secure, schema-aware access to
  commerce operations.
- [Anomaly Detection](https://commercelayer.io/blog/real-time-anomaly-detection):
  Real-time order workflow monitoring that detects deviations from dynamic
  baselines — available on Enterprise plans.
- [Rules Engine deep dive](https://commercelayer.io/blog/rules-engine-flex-promotion-examples):
  Build custom promotions with full flexibility for complex discount logic.
- [External payment gateway with Mollie](https://commercelayer.io/blog/connecting-any-payment-gateway-to-commerce-layer-with-external-payments):
  Connect any payment provider via the external payments feature. Walks through
  an async Mollie integration using Hono + TypeScript, HMAC-signed webhooks,
  and both "Place" and "Authorize" order strategies.
- [SSO with Next.js and Auth0](https://commercelayer.io/blog/single-sign-on-with-commerce-layer-using-next-js-and-auth0):
  Implement single sign-on using Auth0 as the identity provider and Commerce
  Layer for commerce. Covers customer sync, JWT bearer token flow, and
  rendering authenticated order history with React Components.
- [Timed Checkout](https://commercelayer.io/blog/introducing-timed-checkout):
  Set hard checkout deadlines and reserve stock automatically for flash sales
  and limited inventory drops.
- [Metrics Dashboard](https://commercelayer.io/blog/introducing-the-metrics-dashboard):
  Real-time commerce performance monitoring inside Commerce Layer Dashboard.
- [Black Friday 2025](https://commercelayer.io/blog/black-friday-2025):
  260% YoY order growth, zero incidents, globally stable performance.
